title: Kelowna Brewery Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately with closed-toe shoes

Minimum numbers apply. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation within 24 hours of scheduled tour departure if there are not enough passengers to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund.
Rescheduling initiated by the customer may be subject to a change fee.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Welcome to Kelowna! Our brewery tour will take you to 3 breweries along the Kelowna craft beer route. Enjoy flights at each of the craft breweries with an entertaining behind the scenes tour and tasting fees included. We all have different tastes in beer, let us help you find one you love with perfect flights in a growing region for craft beer.

Please note:
-The venues on our tours may vary depending on availability.
-A minimum of 4 guests is required for public tours. If fewer than 4 people are booked, we may need to reschedule.
